title: FastPistons
description: PistonBreaker is a simple and lightweight plugin for Paper/Spigot servers, created by KaiCraft, that allows players to build automatic farms using pistons as crop-growth detectors.
body:
FastPistons is a lightweight and optimized Minecraft plugin for Paper servers. It allows players to build automatic farms using pistons as crop-growth detectors, reducing the need for heavy redstone clocks and helping improve server performance.

The plugin supports crops such as sugar cane, bamboo, cactus, kelp, melon, pumpkin, cocoa and amethyst. It is designed for survival, economy and farming servers that need efficient automatic farms without creating unnecessary lag.

FastPistons is simple to configure, easy to use and focused on performance, stability and clean gameplay.
